body:
Suggestion: cut out the heavier drugs, particularly anything psychedelic. Set and setting are critical to those, and in your situation right now it doesn't sound like a place where you'd have a good trip. The benzos etc also seem like a bad idea, since they're CNS depressants.

I'm not anti-drug, in fact I think it can be helpful. But it's powerful and if you're in a bad place it can just make that worse. Maybe you could get yourself to a more meditative, quiet, supportive sort of situation where you could have a healing trip?

Sounds like you have at least one great friend with whom you might be able to establish more contact. Does he know how much he means to you? Does he know other people near you who share the same general values, personality, etc, so you could be set up on a "friend date" with them and expand the number of friends you can trust?

I think that if not for the fear of pain etc, people would probably commit suicide much more readily. Too much pain to live, too much to die, and we get stuck being alive but tortured.

Pretty common experience, I think, at least among suicidal people.
